# 满返网 Max Rebate

> 独立的外汇与黄金交易返佣信息服务网站，目前专注TMGM返佣与Introducing Broker合作，并非任何交易平台官方网站。

Max Rebate 满返网提供独立的 TMGM 返佣服务：标准账户黄金最高 $20/手，合资格返佣 100% 返还，到账时间以审核和结算规则为准。

## 常见问题

Source: https://max-rebate.com/#faq

- **返佣会影响我的点差或交易条件吗？** 按满返网当前方案，不因为返佣服务额外加点差；实际交易条件仍由平台、账户组别和市场环境决定。
- **“100%返佣”是什么意思？** 指我们把实际收到并可返还给客户的合资格返佣部分 100% 返还，不代表所有交易成本都能被返还。
- **已有 TMGM 账户还能申请吗？** 可以先提交查询。能否调整归属、转组或开启返佣，需要按平台规则人工确认。
- **返佣什么时候到账？** 实际到账时间以账户审核、有效交易记录和平台结算规则为准。
- **网站会要求我的交易密码吗？** 不会。不要提交交易密码、投资者密码、验证码、银行卡密码或证件图片。
- **返佣是不是稳赚？** 不是。返佣只能抵减部分符合条件的交易成本，不降低市场风险，也不保证盈利。
- **代理有什么权限？** 代理权限开通后，可以获得专属开户链接和邀请码用于展业。

## FAQ (English)

Source: https://max-rebate.com/en.html#faq

- **Does the rebate change my spread or trading conditions?** Under the current Max Rebate plan, the rebate service does not add a spread markup. Actual conditions still depend on the platform, account group and market.
- **What does “100% rebate” mean?** We return 100% of the eligible client rebate portion we actually receive and can return. This does not mean that all trading costs are refunded.
- **Can an existing TMGM account apply?** You can request a review. Attribution or group changes remain subject to platform rules.
- **When is the rebate credited?** Actual crediting time depends on account review, eligible trading records and the platform’s settlement rules.
- **Will you ask for my trading password?** No. Never send passwords, verification codes, card passwords or identity-document images.
- **Does a rebate guarantee profit?** No. A rebate may reduce eligible costs but does not reduce market risk or guarantee profit.
- **What permissions does an agent receive?** Once agent access is activated, the agent can receive a dedicated account-opening link and invitation code for business development.
